non_pass_checks.name: index_rule_interpretation
non_pass_checks.evidence: Source section7 applies weight adjustment factors twice yearly, generally fixed before next adjustment. 5%/3% are adjustment-rule caps, not guaranteed continuous fund holding ceilings. Prose omits adjustment timing and would cancel a satellite candidate if later fund weights exceed the index caps. That may be a discretionary stricter risk condition, but must not be treated as evidence of rule breach or automatically extreme concentration. Saved Q3 5.36%/5.18% illustrates the incompatible dates/objects; report does not explicitly assert a legal/compliance breach.
